messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 alert: cont-batch latency p95 > 1.2s, error rate spike on prod-east-1 (kv_cache evictions ↑120% in 5m). auto-page: @oncall
pagerduty: Paging @samir (oncall). severity: P1. runbook: https://go/runbooks/cont-batch
samir: ack. I'm jumping in. tagging @jia and @leo for quick triage.
leo: seeing big queueing on cb-controller: inflight_queue length doubled, avg microbatch_size bumped from 4 -> 12 for many pods. kv cache miss rate up. sample log:
```
2026-03-17T01:12:03Z svc-cont: microbatch size=12, enqueue_ms=320, kv_evictions=87
2026-03-17T01:12:04Z svc-cont: prefix_cache_miss=0.62, tail_latency=1.34s
```
jia: sounds like prefetch/kv feedback loop. recent config rollout (yesterday) increased max_microbatch to 16 for throughput. that + jitter at high concurrency can blow up kv working set and cause eviction storms.
samir: can we mitigate without full rollback? options: 1) reduce max_microbatch to 6-8, 2) temporarily disable prefix caching (reduce memory thrash), 3) enable per-queue circuit breaker to reject bursty requests.
ops: I'll prepare a hotfix patch for cb-controller config. plan: patch configmap -> restart 30% pods -> observe 2 min -> continue rollout.
leo: preliminary customer impact: two customers showing small spike in 5xx: AcmePay ~3% of their requests (peak), BetaRetail ~1.1%. overall request success down ~0.8%. No major SLA breach yet but risk of escalation.
samir: go with option 1 + 2: lower max_microbatch to 8 and set prefix_cache.enabled=false. Jia, can you craft the exact kubectl patch?
jia: applying now. command:
```
kubectl -n prod patch configmap cb-controller-config -p '{"data":{"max_microbatch":"8","prefix_cache_enabled":"false"}}'
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/cb-controller --selector=canary=gold --timeout=2m
```
deploy-bot: Patch applied to configmap cb-controller-config. Starting canary restart (pod/cb-controller-5 -> pod/cb-controller-6). status: 1/3 canary pods restarted
leo: after first canary: inflight_queue down 35%, microbatch median 6, kv_evictions dropping. tail p95 improved ~300ms.
ops: rolling to remaining nodes in waves of 25%. monitoring metrics and logs.
samir: re-enable throttles at ingress to smooth bursts: set burst_limit to 150 -> 50 over 10s. ops can you push that too?
ops: pushed ingress throttle change. command:
```
redwoodctl policies set-ingress --env prod --burst 150 --decay 10s
```
samir: good. monitoring for customer impact. Jia please keep prefix_cache disabled until morning perf validation and we'll test ramping microbatch later.
jia: noted. leaving cache disabled and recording config in incident timeline.
leo: customer tickets: flagged AcmePay support for potential 502s, SME pinged. No escalations yet.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete on 12/12 pods. status: healthy.
samir: p95 improved to normal levels, error rate trending down. closing immediate mitigation. we'll follow up with a root-cause postmortem and a regression test for config rollouts. handoff to next oncall in 30m: @leo to monitor overnight.
ops: added follow-up tasks to backlog: (1) regression test for max_microbatch changes, (2) rate-aware prefetch heuristic, (3) alert for kv_eviction_rate spike threshold.
samir: thanks all. incident-bot, mark incident resolved (mitigated) and create ticket for postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-0317-1766664321. Status: mitigated. Postmortem assigned to samir/jia. :thumbsup:
